⚡ Final review — what to memorize and where you can get tricked

Automatically compiled from the 🧠 Memorize and ⚠️ traps / Learn vs docs notices of each quick sheet. Use it the day before the exam; each title links to its quick sheet.

🧠 Memorize — figures, names and values by module

M1 · Database objects

Memorize:
  • decimal 5/9/13/17 B · datetime2 6/7/8 B · row 8,060 B · 1,024 columns · key 900 B / 1,700 B · 999 NC · 32 columns
  • Rowgroup 1,048,576 · bulk ≥ 102,400 · REORGANIZE ≥ 10% deleted · FK 253 / 10,000 · 15,000 partitions · n boundaries = n + 1
  • SWITCH: empty target + same filegroup + CHECK · temporal: retention INFINITE, batches ≤ 10,000 · ledger: 30 s / 100 K tx / ≤ 200 tables
  • SEQUENCE: bigint, INCREMENT 1, NO CYCLE · JSON index ≤ 249/table · invalid json: error 13609

M2 · Programmability

Memorize:
  • 1,024 columns/view · 2,100 parameters (SP and UDF) · 32 levels (SP/UDF/trigger) · identifier 128 · #p 116 / ##p 128
  • MSTVF = 100 rows · compat 140 interleaved · 150 inlining · 170 OPPO (default in SQL Server 2025, Azure SQL DB and Fabric)
  • THROW ≥ 50,000 · nvarchar(2048) · state 0–255 · severity 16 · TVP < 1,000 rows · QUOTENAME ≤ 258 · @stmt ≤ 2 GB
  • Defaults: XACT_ABORT OFF (ON in triggers) · TSQL_SCALAR_UDF_INLINING ON · INTERLEAVED_EXECUTION_TVF ON · OPTIMIZED_SP_EXECUTESQL OFF

M3 · Advanced T-SQL

Memorize: MAXRECURSION 100 / 0–32767 / 0 = ∞ · NULL ON NULL: OBJECT, OBJECTAGG; ABSENT ON NULL: ARRAY, ARRAYAGG · REGEXP occurrence 0 = all (REPLACE) / 1 (SUBSTR, INSTR); return_option 0 start / 1 end · EDS 0–100, JWD float 0–1 (0 = equal), JWS 0–100 · THROW ≥ 50000, sev 16.

M4 · AI-assisted tools

Memorize: .github/copilot-instructions.md · .github/instructions/*.instructions.md + applyTo · .github/prompts/*.prompt.md · AGENTS.md/CONSTITUTION.md (7,500 bytes) · Fabric F2/P1, changes ≤ 15 min, history 28 days · audit log 180 days · VS Code 128 tools · DAB 7 tools, query-timeout 1–600 (30).

M5 · Security

Memorize: AE AEAD_AES_256_CBC_HMAC_SHA_256 · CEK 256 bits / RSA_OAEP · CEK cache 2 h · SGX end Oct 31, 2027 · Fabric CMK: ≤ 10 min to Inaccessible; if it recovers in ≤ 30 min, self-healing · DDM REGEXP_REPLACE Preview (Azure SQL DB only, T-SQL): pattern ≤ 8,000 B, LOB ≤ 2 MB, flags 'c' · session context 128 B / 8,000 B / 1 MB · audit: QUEUE_DELAY 1000 (0 = synchronous), MAXSIZE ≥ 2 MB, predicate ≤ 3,000 chars · REST: @timeout 1–230 s (30), @retry_count 0–10, 100 MB / 8 KB / 8 KB, 15% workers (max. 175) · DAB 100 / 100,000, MCP 30 s (1–600)

M6 · Performance

Memorize: vCores 2–128 / 2–128 / 2–192 · 4 / 4 / 128 TB · IOPS/vCore 320 / 4,000 / 5,500 · serverless 0.5 vCore min., auto-pause 60 min (15–10,080) · MAXDOP 8 · compat 170 · escalation 5,000 locks (every 1,250) · deadlock monitor 5 s → 100 ms · 1205 / 1222 / 3960 · Query Store 60 min · 900 s · 30 d · 200 plans · 1,024/100/10 MB.

M7 · CI/CD

Memorize: Microsoft.Build.Sql 2.3.0 · SqlPackage 170.5.96 · .NET SDK 8+ · 1033, CI · 1 pre + 1 post · Publish: BlockOnPossibleDataLoss=True, DropObjectsNotInSource=False, CreateNewDatabase=False, RegisterDataTierApplication=False, CommandTimeout=60 · Execution Time 30 s · OIDC ≤ 20 credentials · reviewers ≤ 6 · wait timer 1–43,200 min · secrets 100/100/1,000 and 48 KB.

M8 · DAB & Azure

Memorize: 100 / 100000 · /api /graphql /mcp · cache false, TTL 5, L1L2 · Unauthenticated · X-MS-API-ROLE · Azure SQL logs only via a diagnostic setting · CPU > 90 / workers > 60 / storage > 95 · CES: FULL, 9093, 128–1024 KB (256) · CDC: 3 days, ≤ 2 capture instances · CT: PK required · Functions: 100 / 1000 ms · in-process Nov 10, 2026.

M9 · Models & embeddings

Memorize: MODEL_TYPE = EMBEDDINGS (the only one) · API_FORMAT: Azure OpenAI | OpenAI | Ollama | ONNX Runtime · vector float32 ≤ 1,998 / float16 ≤ 3,996 (4 / 2 B per dim) · 1,536 dims = ada-002 and 3-small, 3,072 = 3-large (only the 3rd gen. accepts dimensions) · 8,192 tokens and 2,048 items per request · retry_count 0–10 · OVERLAP 0–50% (default 0), CHUNK_TYPE = FIXED, compat ≥ 170 · Managed Identity: resourceid = https://cognitiveservices.azure.com · Functions: MaxBatchSize 100, PollingIntervalMs 1000 · CDC: 3 days, capture 20 s, DTU ≥ S3.

M10 · Intelligent search

Memorize: 1,998 (float32) · 3,996 (float16) · header 8 B · page 8,060 B · cosine 0–2, dot negative · ENN < 50,000 vectors · index ≥ 100 rows (Msg 42266), only type DiskANN, ALTER on the table · RRF k = 60 (1/61 + 1/63 = 0.0323) · RANK 0–1000, BM25 only FREETEXTTABLE · errors 42266 / 42274 · PREVIEW_FEATURES default OFF, FULLTEXT_INDEX_VERSION default 2.

M11 · RAG

Memorize: POST · @timeout 30 s (1–230) · @retry_count 0 (0–10) · payload 100 MB · URL 8 KB · query string 4 KB · headers 8 KB · 15% of workers (max. 175) · retries on 408/429/500/502/503/504 · permission EXECUTE ANY EXTERNAL ENDPOINT · option external rest endpoint enabled · JSON_VALUE 4000 chars · path $.result.choices[0].message.content · resourceid = https://cognitiveservices.azure.com · ON by default only in Azure SQL DB and SQL database in Fabric.

⚠️ Traps and Learn ↔ current docs discrepancies — by module

M1 · Database objects

Learn vs docs (recognize both):
  • Types: Learn DECIMAL(10,2) -- 5 bytes and IMAGE / Docs: 9 bytes (5 B only for p ≤ 9); image deprecated
  • In-memory: Learn: no (MAX) / Docs: yes (2016+, off-row)
  • Columnstore: Learn: tuple-mover compresses delta at ≥ 102,400 / Docs: 102,400 = bulk minimum; delta closes at 1,048,576
  • Ledger: Learn WITH (LEDGER = ON) and (LEDGER = ON, APPEND_ONLY = ON) / Docs: SYSTEM_VERSIONING = ON, LEDGER = ON and LEDGER = ON (APPEND_ONLY = ON)
  • Graph: Learn CREATE TABLE Person AS NODE; / Docs: node with ≥ 1 column (Msg 102)
  • JSON: Learn: .modify() Preview, no mention of JSON index / Docs: json, .modify() and JSON index GA
  • SEQUENCE: Learn CREATE TABLE Order and sp_sequence_get_range with INT / Docs: [Order]; outputs sql_variant
  • Partitions: Learn MERGE RANGE ('2023-12-31') and “nonaligned > 1,000 not supported” / Docs: the boundary must exist; “possible but not supported”

M2 · Programmability

Learn vs docs:
  • U7: MSTVF and scalar “black boxes” → docs: interleaved execution (2017) and inlining (2019).
  • U3 + knowledge check: “precompiled” SPs → docs: compile on the 1st execution and cache the plan. SET NOCOUNT ON: Learn “improves performance”; CREATE PROCEDURE “no measurable benefit”.
  • U5: INNER JOIN fn(c.Col) ON 1=1 does not compile (Msg 4104) → CROSS APPLY. U6: tr_UpdateInventory fails with multiple rows of the same ProductID.
  • U4: DATEDIFF(YEAR, …) counts boundaries; GETDATE() = nondeterministic and not inlineable; Learn: “functions with tables = nondeterministic” (the docs allow local data with SCHEMABINDING).
  • Docs vs docs: parameters per UDF 1,024 vs 2,100 (CREATE FUNCTION); SP text “no maximum” vs the smaller of batch size and 250 MB.
  • Traps: ROLLBACK + THROW without ; · EXEC without the word OUTPUT (the variable does not change) · sqlcmd without -I breaks indexed views · trigger that assumes 1 row · Verify: EXECUTE AS in Fabric SQL database (limits = No; CREATE PROCEDURE/TRIGGER include it).

M3 · Advanced T-SQL

Learn vs docs: (1) Learn: JARO_WINKLER_DISTANCE = similarity (1 = identical), no Preview / Docs: distance (0 = identical); similarity = JARO_WINKLER_SIMILARITY; Preview + PREVIEW_FEATURES. (2) Learn: ECMAScript regex, '$1 $2', lookahead, REGEXP_LIKE(…) = 1 / Docs: RE2, '\1 \2', no lookaround, no = 1. (3) Learn: JSON_ARRAYAGG 2022+ / Docs: *AGG 2025; Learn: JSON_CONTAINS(@nvarchar, '"sql"', '$.tags') / Docs: value 'sql', path '$.tags[*]', target json (8116). (4) Learn: with XACT_ABORT ON it is already rolled back and THROW includes a stack trace / Docs: in TRY it stays −1 (explicit ROLLBACK); no stack trace. (5) Learn: EXISTS outperforms IN / Docs: no difference (NOT IN + NULL matters).
Verify (17.0.1145): EDIT_DISTANCE with maximum_distance exceeded returned maximum_distance (docs: +1); literal & in REGEXP_REPLACE (\& yes).

M4 · AI-assisted tools

Learn vs docs: Learn: prompt files with {{procedureName}} and # / Docs: ${input:var} and /name · Learn: Chat: Configure Instructions / Docs: Chat: Open Customizations (VS Code 1.143: Configure Instructions & Rules...) · Learn: “Copilot and Azure OpenAI Service” section / Docs: “Copilot and AI” group · Learn: ms-fabric.vscode-fabric-mcp-server / Docs and Marketplace: fabric.vscode-fabric-mcp-server · Learn: Azure MCP Server “query your databases” / Docs: control plane only · data agent GA (concept) / Preview (Release status).
Traps: copilot-instructions.md goes in .github/, not directly in the root · VS Code does not apply custom instructions to inline suggestions (the MSSQL ext page says the opposite: Verify).

M5 · Security

Learn vs current docs and traps:
  • DDM — Learn: 4 functions; “SELECT + ALTER bypasses the mask”. Docs: 5 (+ regex Preview); changing the mask requires ALTER ANY MASK + ALTER.
  • Auditing — Learn: ALTER DATABASE AUDIT SPECIFICATION in Azure SQL DB and Purview in Fabric. Docs: portal/PS/CLI/REST/ARM; Fabric → OneLake.
  • Models — Learn: Cognitive Services User, {"resourceId": "…com/"}, AzureOpenAICredential, TYPE = REST. Docs: Cognitive Services OpenAI User, {"resourceid":"https://cognitiveservices.azure.com"}, credential = URL, JSON_QUERY(@response,'$.result.data[0].embedding').
  • DAB — Learn: authentication at the root, fields in the permission, mcpServers. Docs: runtime.host.authentication, fields in the action, dml-tools. Fabric SQL DB — Learn suggests AE; docs: AE not supported.
  • DENY wins · RLS applies to db_owner · explicit STATE = ON · DDM and AE cannot be combined · TDE does not protect against users · email(): aXXX@XXXX.com / aXX@XXXX.com (SQL Server / Azure SQL)

M6 · Performance

Learn vs current docs:
  • Plan: Learn “left to right, top to bottom” · Docs: right → left, top to bottom (data flow; SELECT on the left; both directions work).
  • Hyperscale: Learn “the widest variety of workloads” · Docs: “recommended and default tier” for new OLTP/HTAP; AHB no longer on new HS DBs.
  • ALLOW_SNAPSHOT_ISOLATION: Learn “you must enable it” · Docs: already ON in Azure SQL DB (OFF in SQL Server and MI).
  • QUERY_CAPTURE_MODE: Learn lab: ALL records short SP calls that AUTO “might skip” · Docs: SPs, cursors and natively compiled are always captured; default 2019+: ALTER DATABASE = AUTO, sys.database_query_store_options = ALL.
  • Learn “six levels” · SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL accepts 5. ROLLBACK in CATCH after 1205 · already rolled back (3903). 5%/30% fragmentation: classic heuristic.
  • Verify: DOP_FEEDBACK in Azure SQL DB (ON in SQL Server 2025; the reference still says “default OFF”) → sys.database_scoped_configurations · hint DISABLE_PARAMETER_SENSITIVE_PLAN (in the PSP doc, not in the USE HINT list) → sys.dm_exec_valid_use_hints.

M7 · CI/CD

Learn vs docs: Learn: azure/login@v2 without permissions: id-token: write and azure/sql-action@v2.3; docs: azure/login@v3 (id-token: write required) and @v2.4 (the @v2 tag does not float: it is the 2022 v2.0; summary/comment-pr/outputs only on master). ADO in Learn: AuthenticationType: server + $(SqlPassword); prefer servicePrincipal/WIF. DacpacVerify: Learn without flag, docs --prerelease. SQLCMD without /v: docs SQL projects = empty; Publish ref. = error. SSMS Database DevOps: GA since 22.10.2. CODEOWNERS only requests the review (Learn says “requires”): you need Require review from Code Owners. Wait timer: GitHub = after the job is triggered; Learn = between approval and execution.
Traps: “authentication tables” is only in the study guide → pipeline authentication (OIDC/SP/MI/secrets) + users/roles as code without secrets · with environment: the OIDC subject changes · clean merge ≠ valid schema (rebuild) · tSQLt requires CLR (not official in Azure SQL DB).

M8 · DAB & Azure

Learn vs docs:
  • Learn: dab start --config dab-config.production.json merges; mappings; rest.methods object; cache inside graphql; parameters dictionary / Current docs: merges DAB_ENVIRONMENT; fields[].alias; methods array, SP only; cache alongside rest/graphql; parameters array.
  • Learn: SWA with az staticwebapp dbconnection create --db-type and staticwebapps.database.config.json / Current docs: retired; no --db-type; file staticwebapp.database.config.json.
  • Learn: DAB “detects” APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING; requests/failed > 5 = “5%” / Current docs: you must enable application-insights; it is a count.
  • Learn: CREATE EVENT STREAMING GROUP … TARGET_TYPE='eventhub', CES “sub-second”, [FunctionName] / Current docs: sp_create_event_stream_group, near real-time, Preview; [Function].
  • Traps: source.type: view does not prevent writing · anonymous does not imply read-only · health.roles empty in prod ⇒ 403 · set-session-context: true or OBO ⇒ no cache.

M9 · Models & embeddings

Learn vs docs:
  • Permission — Learn: GRANT EXECUTE ANY EXTERNAL ENDPOINT / Current docs: EXECUTE ON EXTERNAL MODEL::m for AI_GENERATE_EMBEDDINGS; the first only for direct REST.
  • Role (Managed Identity → Azure OpenAI) — Learn: Cognitive Services OpenAI User / Docs (SQL Server 2025 + Arc): Cognitive Services OpenAI Contributor (includes User); Cognitive Services Contributor does not allow inference with Entra ID.
  • Return — Learn and GA blog: scalar function (returns a vector) / Docs (reference): “single-column table”.
  • API_FORMAT — GA blog: only Azure OpenAI and OpenAI / reference: 4 values; ALTER EXTERNAL MODEL lists 3 (without ONNX Runtime).
  • Traps: endpoint of the Foundry OpenAI tab, not *.services.ai.azure.com · c.chunk, not c.chunk_text · 3-large does not fit in float32 · float16 = Preview in SQL Server 2025 · Azure SQL MI: EXTERNAL MODEL, embeddings and vector only with the Always-up-to-date policy · CES = Preview.

M10 · Intelligent search

Learn vs docs and traps:
  • Question with TOP_N, read-only table or int PK → previous index (Learn); current Azure SQL DB / Fabric → v3 with TOP (N) WITH APPROXIMATE. Recognize both.
  • Only VECTOR_SEARCH uses the index (VECTOR_DISTANCE never does). Different metric or column → warning + kNN.
  • 1 / (60 + rank) with integers gives 0: use 1.0 /. TOP without ORDER BY (module CTE) returns arbitrary rows.

M11 · RAG

Learn vs current docs:
  • Enablement — Learn: “by default only in Azure SQL Database” / Docs: also SQL database in Fabric; OFF in SQL Server 2025 and MI.
  • Payload — Learn and lab: max_tokens + temperature (500 / 0.5) with gpt-5.x / Docs: reasoning models only max_completion_tokens (Responses: max_output_tokens) and max_tokens, temperature, top_p not supported except GPT-6 Astra → possible HTTP 400 (verify). Recognize both on the exam.
  • URL — Learn: /openai/deployments/<d>/chat/completions?api-version=2024-10-21 / Docs: v1 /openai/v1/chat/completions (no api-version, with model).
  • Errors — Learn: RAISERROR / Docs: THROW. RBAC — SP doc: OpenAI User / CREATE EXTERNAL MODEL (Arc): OpenAI Contributor; User is enough.
  • Retrieval — lab: VECTOR_SEARCH … TOP_N (deprecated) / Docs: SELECT TOP (N) WITH APPROXIMATE; GA in Azure SQL DB and Fabric, Preview in SQL Server 2025.
  • Exam trap: ALTER ANY DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL does not exist; creating a credential = CONTROL.

⚡ Quick sheet — Design and develop database solutions

The essentials to memorize: syntax, values, limits and decision rules. The full details (with examples, sources and warnings) are in the sections of each module.

⚡ M1 · Design and implement database objects with SQL — the essentials

Types and limits

decimal(p,s)p ≤ 9 → 5 B · ≤ 19 → 9 B · ≤ 28 → 13 B · ≤ 38 → 17 B; default (18,0)
datetime2 · datetimeoffset · time6/7/8 B · 8/9/10 B · 3/4/5 B (precision < 3 / 3–4 / 5–7); default 7
float(n)n 1–24 → 4 B · 25–53 → 8 B (default 53)
varchar(n) · nvarchar(n)n ≤ 8,000 · ≤ 4,000; default 1 (DECLARE) · 30 (CAST)
Row · columns8,060 B (+7 B overhead; error 1701) · 1,024 (30,000 with column set)
Index key900 B clustered · 1,700 B NC · 32 columns · 999 NC per table

Columns and constraints

  • IDENTITY(seed, incr): both or neither; does not guarantee uniqueness or the absence of gaps
  • Computed: CHECK/FK/NOT NULL require PERSISTED (8183) · SPARSE: nullable, no DEFAULT/PK or compression
  • PK → clustered by default · UNIQUE → nonclustered, only one NULL · CHECK lets NULL through
  • FK: NO ACTION (default) | CASCADE | SET NULL | SET DEFAULT; does not create an index; cycles → 1785
  • NOCHECK only FK/CHECK; re-enabling without WITH CHECK = not trusted
ALTER TABLE dbo.O NOCHECK CONSTRAINT FK_O_C;
ALTER TABLE dbo.O WITH CHECK CHECK CONSTRAINT ALL;

SEQUENCE

AS · STARTbigint · MINVALUE (asc.) / MAXVALUE (desc.)
INCREMENT1 (≠ 0); MIN/MAX = type range (tinyint 0–255)
CYCLE · CACHENO CYCLE · CACHE (size chosen by the engine)
  • NEXT VALUE FOR: OVER (ORDER BY) yes, PARTITION BY no; not in WHERE/TOP/DISTINCT/subquery/view/UDF/CHECK; yes in DEFAULT (only way in MERGE)
CREATE SEQUENCE dbo.Seq AS int START WITH 1000 INCREMENT BY 1 NO CYCLE CACHE 50;
SELECT NEXT VALUE FOR dbo.Seq;

Rowstore indexes

  • OFF by default: PAD_INDEX, SORT_IN_TEMPDB, IGNORE_DUP_KEY, ONLINE, RESUMABLE, OPT_FOR_SEQ_KEY · FILLFACTOR 0 (= 100; valid 1–100) · MAXDOP 0 (max. 64)
  • RESUMABLE requires ONLINE = ON; MAX_DURATION 1–10,080 min; WAIT_AT_LOW_PRIORITY (MAX_DURATION, ABORT_AFTER_WAIT = NONE | SELF | BLOCKERS)
  • Filtered: only NC; AND yes, OR no; IS NULL yes; no IGNORE_DUP_KEY
CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX UX_C ON dbo.Customer (Email) INCLUDE (Name)
  WHERE Email IS NOT NULL WITH (FILLFACTOR = 90, ONLINE = ON);

Columnstore

  • Rowgroup ≤ 1,048,576 rows; bulk ≥ 102,400 → directly to compressed, otherwise → delta
  • state_desc: 0 INVISIBLE · 1 OPEN · 2 CLOSED · 3 COMPRESSED · 4 TOMBSTONE
  • CCI = whole table (DW) · NCCI = columnar copy on top of OLTP (supports WHERE); 1 columnstore per table (35339); NCCI without INCLUDE, ASC/DESC, (max) or SPARSE
  • REORGANIZE (online): cleans up rowgroups with ≥ 10% deleted; COMPRESS_ALL_ROW_GROUPS = ON
  • DATA_COMPRESSION = COLUMNSTORE | COLUMNSTORE_ARCHIVE (not ROW/PAGE)
  • ORDER: CCI 2022+, NCCI 2025+; goes before WITH
CREATE CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX CCI_S ON dbo.SalesHistory
    ORDER (SaleDate) WITH (MAXDOP = 1);

In-memory OLTP

  • MEMORY_OPTIMIZED = ON; DURABILITY: SCHEMA_AND_DATA (default; requires PK) | SCHEMA_ONLY
  • Index NONCLUSTERED or HASH WITH (BUCKET_COUNT = n): n ≈ 1–2× distinct values, power of 2, max. 1,073,741,824; hash = equality on the whole key, ranges → NC
  • Up to 999 indexes (previously 8); NC key ≤ 2,500 B; only IDENTITY(1,1)
  • No: datetimeoffset, geography/geometry, hierarchyid, rowversion, sql_variant, xml, UDT, json, vector; nor MERGE as target, compression or partitioning
  • Native proc: WITH NATIVE_COMPILATION, SCHEMABINDING + BEGIN ATOMIC WITH (TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL = SNAPSHOT, LANGUAGE = N'us_english')

Temporal

CREATE TABLE dbo.E (Id int PRIMARY KEY,
  F datetime2 GENERATED ALWAYS AS ROW START HIDDEN NOT NULL,
  T datetime2 GENERATED ALWAYS AS ROW END   HIDDEN NOT NULL,
  PERIOD FOR SYSTEM_TIME (F, T))
WITH (SYSTEM_VERSIONING = ON (HISTORY_TABLE = dbo.E_H, HISTORY_RETENTION_PERIOD = 6 MONTHS));
  • PK required; period datetime2 NOT NULL (UTC); history with no PK/FK/constraints/triggers; no TRUNCATE or INSTEAD OF
  • AS OF t: F ≤ t < T · FROM a TO b excludes b · BETWEEN a AND b includes b · CONTAINED IN (a, b) · ALL
  • Retention DAYS | WEEKS | MONTHS | YEARS (default INFINITE); cleanup in batches ≤ 10,000 rows

Ledger Not in Fabric

  • Updatable: WITH (SYSTEM_VERSIONING = ON, LEDGER = ON) → 4 columns + history + <t>_Ledger view · Append-only: WITH (LEDGER = ON (APPEND_ONLY = ON)) → 2 columns
  • ledger_operation_type: 1 INSERT · 2 DELETE (UPDATE = 2 + 1); CREATE DATABASE … WITH LEDGER = ON irreversible
  • Block ≈ 30 s or 100 K tx; digests in Blob with an immutability policy (sqldbledgerdigests) or Confidential Ledger
  • No: existing table, TRUNCATE, in-memory, graph, xml/sql_variant/UDT/FILESTREAM/vector/json; ≤ 200 ledger tables per tx

Graph

CREATE TABLE Person (ID int PRIMARY KEY, name varchar(100)) AS NODE;
CREATE TABLE likes (rating int) AS EDGE;
SELECT p.name FROM Person p, likes l, Person q WHERE MATCH(p-(l)->q);
  • Node ≥ 1 column; edge can have no columns · $node_id; edge: $edge_id, $from_id, $to_id; 1 logical graph per DB
  • MATCH only in WHERE with AND; SHORTEST_PATH (2019+): FOR PATH + WITHIN GROUP (GRAPH PATH)
  • Edge constraint: CONNECTION (A TO B[, C TO D]) + ON DELETE NO ACTION | CASCADE; not in temp/temporal/memory-optimized/ledger

External tables Preview: Azure SQL DB · Fabric

  • Order: master key (if SECRET) → DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL → EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE → EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT → EXTERNAL TABLE
  • LOCATION: abs://, adls://, s3://, sqlserver://, oracle://, teradata://, mongodb://, odbc://; https:// = bulk only
  • FORMAT_TYPE: PARQUET · DELIMITEDTEXT (SQL Server) / CSV (Azure SQL, Fabric) · DELTA 1.0; ORC/RCFILE no longer (2022+); no PolyBase for Parquet/Delta/ABS/ADLS/S3
  • Azure SQL DB: elastic query with TYPE = RDBMS; Azure SQL/Fabric: read-only (CETAS disabled by default in MI)

JSON GA

CREATE TABLE dbo.Orders (OrderID int IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, Doc json NOT NULL);
CREATE JSON INDEX IX_Doc ON dbo.Orders (Doc) FOR ('$.customer', '$.basket');
SELECT OrderID FROM dbo.Orders WHERE JSON_VALUE(Doc, '$.customer.id' RETURNING int) = 16167;
  • json: object/array only (scalar, null, '' → 13609); duplicates → keeps the first; ≤ 2 GB; .modify()
  • JSON index: 1 per column (≤ 249/table), requires a clustering key, offline only, paths must not overlap; used by JSON_VALUE =, JSON_PATH_EXISTS, JSON_CONTAINS (not LIKE/IS NULL)
  • RETURNING only with json input (without it: nvarchar(4000)); JSON_CONTAINS(target, search [, path] [, mode]): path currently required, [*] in arrays

Partitioning

CREATE PARTITION FUNCTION PF (date) AS RANGE RIGHT FOR VALUES ('2025-01-01', '2025-04-01');
CREATE PARTITION SCHEME PS AS PARTITION PF ALL TO ([PRIMARY]);
CREATE TABLE dbo.T (Id int NOT NULL, D date NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_T PRIMARY KEY (Id, D)) ON PS (D);
  • n boundaries = n + 1 partitions; LEFT (default) = the boundary closes the left side · RIGHT = opens the right side (dates); NULL → partition 1
  • PK/UNIQUE include the partitioning column; aligned indexes; Azure SQL DB/Fabric only [PRIMARY]
  • SPLIT: NEXT USED first (it is consumed) · MERGE: the boundary must exist · SWITCH: empty target + same structure/filegroup + CHECK
  • Columnstore: SPLIT only on an empty partition; MERGE does not merge two non-empty ones → SWITCH to staging

Memorize:
  • decimal 5/9/13/17 B · datetime2 6/7/8 B · row 8,060 B · 1,024 columns · key 900 B / 1,700 B · 999 NC · 32 columns
  • Rowgroup 1,048,576 · bulk ≥ 102,400 · REORGANIZE ≥ 10% deleted · FK 253 / 10,000 · 15,000 partitions · n boundaries = n + 1
  • SWITCH: empty target + same filegroup + CHECK · temporal: retention INFINITE, batches ≤ 10,000 · ledger: 30 s / 100 K tx / ≤ 200 tables

Learn vs docs (recognize both):
  • Types: Learn DECIMAL(10,2) -- 5 bytes and IMAGE / Docs: 9 bytes (5 B only for p ≤ 9); image deprecated
  • In-memory: Learn: no (MAX) / Docs: yes (2016+, off-row)
  • Columnstore: Learn: tuple-mover compresses delta at ≥ 102,400 / Docs: 102,400 = bulk minimum; delta closes at 1,048,576
  • Ledger: Learn WITH (LEDGER = ON) and (LEDGER = ON, APPEND_ONLY = ON) / Docs: SYSTEM_VERSIONING = ON, LEDGER = ON and LEDGER = ON (APPEND_ONLY = ON)
  • Graph: Learn CREATE TABLE Person AS NODE; / Docs: node with ≥ 1 column (Msg 102)
  • JSON: Learn: .modify() Preview, no mention of JSON index / Docs: json, .modify() and JSON index GA
  • SEQUENCE: Learn CREATE TABLE Order and sp_sequence_get_range with INT / Docs: [Order]; outputs sql_variant
  • Partitions: Learn MERGE RANGE ('2023-12-31') and “nonaligned > 1,000 not supported” / Docs: the boundary must exist; “possible but not supported”

⚡ M2 · Programmability objects — the essentials

View: syntax, rules and DML

CREATE [OR ALTER] VIEW s.v [(col,…)]
[WITH ENCRYPTION | SCHEMABINDING | VIEW_METADATA]
AS select_statement [WITH CHECK OPTION];
  • ≤ 1,024 columns · 1st statement in the batch (Msg 111) · CREATE VIEW + ALTER on the schema
  • No: INTO, OPTION, #temp, table variables; ORDER BY only with TOP/OFFSET/FOR XML
  • SELECT * gets “frozen” → sp_refreshview; SCHEMABINDING: 2-part names, same DB, no SELECT *
  • DML on only 1 base table (2 → Msg 4405), no aggregates/calculations/UNION or GROUP BY/HAVING/DISTINCT; otherwise: INSTEAD OF trigger
  • WITH CHECK OPTION: only checks the DML done through the view (Msg 550); not with TOP; prevents an INSTEAD OF trigger

Indexed view

CREATE VIEW s.v WITH SCHEMABINDING AS
SELECT k, SUM(ISNULL(x,0)) AS t, COUNT_BIG(*) AS n
FROM s.T GROUP BY k;
CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX ix ON s.v(k);
  • SCHEMABINDING + deterministic and precise (no float in the key) + 2-part names + only base tables from the same DB
  • GROUP BY ⇒ COUNT_BIG(*), no HAVING, SUM non-nullable; index only with GROUP BY cols
  • 1st index UNIQUE CLUSTERED; IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF
  • No COUNT, AVG/MIN/MAX, DISTINCT, TOP, CTE/subquery, OUTER JOIN, APPLY, UNION, OVER, TVF, PIVOT
  • SET ON: ARITHABORT (default OFF in OLE DB/ODBC), ANSI_NULLS, ANSI_PADDING, ANSI_WARNINGS, CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL, QUOTED_IDENTIFIER · OFF: NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT
  • Standard: WITH (NOEXPAND); Enterprise/Azure SQL: automatic; OPTION (EXPAND VIEWS) prevents it

Scalar UDF

CREATE [OR ALTER] FUNCTION s.f (@p type [= default])
RETURNS type
[WITH ENCRYPTION | SCHEMABINDING | EXECUTE AS …
  | RETURNS NULL ON NULL INPUT | CALLED ON NULL INPUT
  | INLINE = ON | OFF]
AS BEGIN … RETURN expr END
  • Call with a ≥ 2-part name; with a default ⇒ pass DEFAULT
  • ≤ 2,100 parameters, no OUTPUT; return: anything except table, cursor, timestamp
  • No: TRY…CATCH, THROW/RAISERROR, SET, dynamic SQL, #temp, FOR XML, user SPs, NEWID/RAND (Msg 443)
  • Deterministic ⇒ SCHEMABINDING

Scalar UDF inlining SQL Server 2019+ Azure SQL Fabric SQL DB

ALTER DATABASE SCOPED CONFIGURATION SET TSQL_SCALAR_UDF_INLINING = OFF;  -- DB
OPTION (USE HINT('DISABLE_TSQL_SCALAR_UDF_INLINING'))                    -- query
CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION … WITH INLINE = OFF …                           -- UDF
  • Requires compat ≥ 150; eligible: sys.sql_modules.is_inlineable = 1; inlined: plan without <UserDefinedFunction>
  • UDF without: GETDATE()/NEWSEQUENTIALID(), EXECUTE AS ≠ CALLER, table var/TVP, UDT, CTE, @@ROWCOUNT, STRING_AGG, XML, > 1 RETURN, ORDER BY without TOP 1, signed
  • Query without: UDF in ORDER BY/GROUP BY, computed column/CHECK, CTE, GROUPING SETS/CUBE/ROLLUP, RETURN f()
  • View with an inlineable UDF: cannot be indexed

TVF: inline vs multi-statement

CREATE FUNCTION s.f (@id int) RETURNS TABLE
AS RETURN (SELECT … WHERE c = @id);
CREATE FUNCTION s.g (@d date) RETURNS @r TABLE (…)
AS BEGIN … RETURN; END;
  • iTVF: 1 SELECT, expands like a view with parameters; no EXECUTE AS
  • MSTVF: fixed 100 rows (SQL 2014+; previously 1); interleaved execution with compat ≥ 140 (INTERLEAVED_EXECUTION_TVF)
  • CROSS APPLY ≈ INNER · OUTER APPLY ≈ LEFT; a JOIN does not pass columns

CREATE PROCEDURE

CREATE [OR ALTER] PROC s.p [;n]
  (@p type [VARYING] [= default] [OUT | OUTPUT | READONLY])
[WITH ENCRYPTION | RECOMPILE | EXECUTE AS …]
[FOR REPLICATION]  AS …
  • ≤ 2,100 parameters · 32 levels (@@NESTLEVEL) · text ≤ the smaller of batch size and 250 MB
  • #p ≤ 116 and ##p ≤ 128 chars · no sp_ prefix
  • Not in the body: CREATE/ALTER for TRIGGER/FUNCTION/PROC/VIEW, USE, SET SHOWPLAN_*
  • CREATE PROCEDURE + ALTER on the schema, or db_ddladmin · FOR REPLICATION: no parameters
  • OPPO SQL Server 2025: compat 170 + OPTIONAL_PARAMETER_OPTIMIZATION for col = @p OR @p IS NULL

SP: parameters, OUTPUT, TVP

DECLARE @t decimal(18,2), @rc int;
EXEC @rc = s.p @ids = @x, @Total = @t OUTPUT;
EXEC s.p @x, DEFAULT, @t OUTPUT;
  • OUTPUT in the declaration and in the call; after @p = value, everything named (Msg 119)
  • Outputs: result sets · OUTPUT · RETURN int (RETURN NULL → 0) · INSERT t EXEC p captures the result set
  • TVP: CREATE TYPE … AS TABLE; READONLY (Msg 352), no statistics, ideal < 1,000 rows; EXECUTE + REFERENCES permissions on the type

Errors, transactions and dynamic SQL

SET NOCOUNT, XACT_ABORT ON;
BEGIN TRY BEGIN TRAN; …; COMMIT; END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
  IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK; THROW;
END CATCH
  • THROW: number ≥ 50,000 · message nvarchar(2048) · state 0–255 · severity 16 · preceding ; · respects XACT_ABORT (RAISERROR does not)
  • XACT_ABORT default OFF (ON in triggers and atomic blocks)
  • sp_executesql N'…', N'@p int OUTPUT', @p = v: @stmt Unicode constant/variable, no concatenation (≤ 2 GB)
  • QUOTENAME(@v) for names · literal ≤ 128: QUOTENAME(@v,'''') · > 128: REPLACE(@v,'''','''''')

DML triggers

CREATE [OR ALTER] TRIGGER s.t ON {table | view}
[WITH ENCRYPTION | EXECUTE AS …]
{FOR | AFTER | INSTEAD OF} {INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE}
[NOT FOR REPLICATION] AS …
  • AFTER/FOR tables only; INSTEAD OF tables and views (1 per operation and object)
  • Once per statement ⇒ multi-row logic; inserted/deleted (UPDATE: both)
  • IF ROWCOUNT_BIG() = 0 RETURN; as the 1st statement
  • UPDATE(col) is TRUE even if it does not change · COLUMNS_UPDATED(): bit 2^(ordinal−1)
  • TRUNCATE does not fire · OUTPUT without INTO fails (Msg 334) · ROLLBACK aborts the batch (Msg 3609)
  • Create: ALTER on the table/view · Azure SQL DB/Fabric: only WITH EXECUTE AS · memory-optimized: NATIVE_COMPILATION, SCHEMABINDING, EXECUTE AS

Triggers: order, defaults, DDL and logon

  • INSTEAD OF → constraints → AFTER; sp_settriggerorder First/Last (1 + 1 per operation; ALTER TRIGGER clears it)
  • Defaults: RECURSIVE_TRIGGERS OFF (only blocks direct recursion) · nested triggers 1 · disallow results from triggers 0
  • DDL/logon: ON {ALL SERVER | DATABASE} · only FOR/AFTER · EVENTDATA() · permission ALTER ANY DATABASE DDL TRIGGER / CONTROL SERVER
  • Logon: ROLLBACK denies the login; PRINT → error log; rescue: DAC or -f
  • SQL Server and MI: all · Azure SQL DB Fabric: only ON DATABASE, no logon

Module security

  • Ownership chaining: same owner ⇒ EXECUTE/SELECT on the module is enough; DML only; breaks with dynamic SQL, TRUNCATE/DDL and another DB
  • EXECUTE AS CALLER (default) | SELF | OWNER | 'user'; not in iTVF; DDL/logon: no OWNER
  • Azure SQL DB: no EXECUTE AS LOGIN, TRUSTWORTHY or cross-DB chaining

Memorize:
  • 1,024 columns/view · 2,100 parameters (SP and UDF) · 32 levels (SP/UDF/trigger) · identifier 128 · #p 116 / ##p 128
  • MSTVF = 100 rows · compat 140 interleaved · 150 inlining · 170 OPPO (default in SQL Server 2025, Azure SQL DB and Fabric)
  • THROW ≥ 50,000 · nvarchar(2048) · state 0–255 · severity 16 · TVP < 1,000 rows · QUOTENAME ≤ 258 · @stmt ≤ 2 GB
  • Defaults: XACT_ABORT OFF (ON in triggers) · TSQL_SCALAR_UDF_INLINING ON · INTERLEAVED_EXECUTION_TVF ON · OPTIMIZED_SP_EXECUTESQL OFF
Learn vs docs:
  • U7: MSTVF and scalar “black boxes” → docs: interleaved execution (2017) and inlining (2019).
  • U3 + knowledge check: “precompiled” SPs → docs: compile on the 1st execution and cache the plan. SET NOCOUNT ON: Learn “improves performance”; CREATE PROCEDURE “no measurable benefit”.
  • U5: INNER JOIN fn(c.Col) ON 1=1 does not compile (Msg 4104) → CROSS APPLY. U6: tr_UpdateInventory fails with multiple rows of the same ProductID.
  • U4: DATEDIFF(YEAR, …) counts boundaries; GETDATE() = nondeterministic and not inlineable; Learn: “functions with tables = nondeterministic” (the docs allow local data with SCHEMABINDING).
  • Docs vs docs: parameters per UDF 1,024 vs 2,100 (CREATE FUNCTION); SP text “no maximum” vs the smaller of batch size and 250 MB.
  • Traps: ROLLBACK + THROW without ; · EXEC without the word OUTPUT (the variable does not change) · sqlcmd without -I breaks indexed views · trigger that assumes 1 row · Verify: EXECUTE AS in Fabric SQL database (limits = No; CREATE PROCEDURE/TRIGGER include it).

⚡ M3 · Write advanced T-SQL code — the essentials

CTE and recursion

WITH n AS (SELECT 1 AS i UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < 200)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM n OPTION (MAXRECURSION 0);   -- 200
  • ;WITH: preceding statement terminated with ; (Msg 319). Not allowed: ORDER BY without TOP (1033), INTO, OPTION, EXEC, nested WITH.
  • MAXRECURSION 0–32767, default 100, 0 = no limit; exceeding it → Msg 530.
  • Recursive: no DISTINCT/GROUP BY/TOP (461)/OUTER JOIN (462); types = anchor (240). Fabric DW: no recursive CTEs; nested Preview.

Window functions

  • OVER ([PARTITION BY] [ORDER BY] [ROWS|RANGE …]); RANGE only UNBOUNDED/CURRENT ROW (4194).
  • ORDER BY with no frame = RANGE UNBOUNDED PRECEDING → CURRENT ROW ⇒ LAST_VALUE = current row. No frame: ranking, LAG/LEAD, NTILE, PERCENT_RANK, CUME_DIST.
  • Not in WHERE (4108 → CTE). WINDOW w AS (…): 2022+, compat ≥ 160 (Msg 102).
  • ROW_NUMBER/RANK/DENSE_RANK → bigint (1,2,3 · 1,1,3 · 1,1,2). LAG|LEAD(scalar_expression [, offset=1 [, default]]) [IGNORE|RESPECT NULLS]; IGNORE NULLS 2022+.

JSON · read and validate (signatures)

JSON_VALUE(expression, path [RETURNING data_type])scalar: nvarchar(4000); RETURNING only json

JSON_MODIFY(expression, [append] [lax|strict] path, newValue)1 change/call

JSON · build and search (signatures)

FunctionSignatureDefault

JSON · paths and rules

  • [lax|strict] $.a.b[0]: 0-based; lax (default) → NULL, strict → error.
  • JSON_MODIFY: lax + NULL deletes the key; strict + NULL sets null. [*], [0 to 2], [last]: json input only.
  • OPENJSON type: 0 null · 1 string · 2 number · 3 bool · 4 array · 5 object; AS JSON ⇒ nvarchar(max) (13618); CROSS APPLY discards JSON NULL/empty, OUTER APPLY does not.

json type and JSON index GA

CREATE TABLE dbo.Docs (id int PRIMARY KEY, Body json NOT NULL);
UPDATE dbo.Docs SET Body.modify('$.a', 2);
CREATE JSON INDEX ix ON dbo.Docs (Body) FOR ('$.a', '$.tags')
  WITH (OPTIMIZE_FOR_ARRAY_SEARCH = ON);
  • Object/array only (13609); json→text with CAST (257). JSON index: clustered PK (13672), 1 per column (13681), ≤ 249/table, no overlapping paths (13683), ONLINE = OFF.

REGEXP · signatures GA

FunctionAfter string_expression, pattern_expressionDefaults · returns
REGEXP_LIKE[, flags]predicate (no = 1)
REGEXP_REPLACE[, string_replacement [, start [, occurrence [, flags]]]]start 1, occurrence 0 = all

REGEXP · flags, RE2 and limits

  • Optional from the right: flags in REGEXP_SUBSTR requires start and occurrence.
  • flags: i · c (default) · m · s; ≤ 30 chars; the last one wins ('ic' → case-sensitive); any other → Msg 19303.
  • RE2: no lookaround or backreference in the pattern (19300). Replacement: \1…\9; $1 comes out literally. start < 1 → 19301.
  • String 2 MB, pattern 8,000 B, {n,m} ≤ 1,000.

Fuzzy matching Preview

EDIT_DISTANCE_SIMILARITY—int 0–100 (100 = identical)
JARO_WINKLER_DISTANCE—float 0–1, 0 = identical
JARO_WINKLER_SIMILARITY—int 0–100 (100 = identical)
  • ALTER DATABASE SCOPED CONFIGURATION SET PREVIEW_FEATURES = ON; (default OFF); without it Msg 195. ('Colour','Color') → 1 · 83 · 0.0333 · 97.

SQL Graph GA not in Fabric Warehouse

CREATE TABLE dbo.Person (id int PRIMARY KEY, n nvarchar(50)) AS NODE;
CREATE TABLE dbo.friendOf (since date) AS EDGE;
SELECT p2.n FROM dbo.Person p1, dbo.friendOf f, dbo.Person p2
WHERE MATCH(p1-(f)->p2) AND p1.n = N'Alice';
  • $node_id; edge $edge_id, $from_id, $to_id. MATCH: unique edge alias (13903); no OR/NOT (13905).
  • MATCH(SHORTEST_PATH(p1(-(e)->p2){1,3})) or + (not *); FOR PATH (13948); STRING_AGG/LAST_VALUE/COUNT(expr) WITHIN GROUP (GRAPH PATH); LAST_NODE(). 2017+ (SHORTEST_PATH 2019+).

Correlated · EXISTS · APPLY

  • With =, <… the subquery must return 1 value (Msg 512); ORDER BY only with TOP/OFFSET (1033). NOT IN with any NULL → 0 rows; EXISTS/NOT EXISTS are NULL-safe.
  • CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP (n) … ORDER BY …) = top-N per group; OUTER APPLY keeps the row with NULL.

TRY…CATCH · XACT_STATE

SET XACT_ABORT ON;
BEGIN TRY
  BEGIN TRAN;  /* DML */  COMMIT;
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK; THROW; END CATCH;
  • Does not catch: sev ≤ 10, sev ≥ 20 that terminates the connection, attention, KILL, syntax/object name errors at the same level (208). ERROR_*() = NULL outside the CATCH.
  • XACT_STATE(): 1 commit possible · 0 no tran · −1 uncommittable (ROLLBACK only). XACT_ABORT ON + error in TRY ⇒ −1.

Security: data and access

  • Credentials (prompts, instruction files, mcp.json) → env vars, inputs with "password": true, Key Vault
  • Privileges → dedicated read-only account (schema only if enough); agentExecuteAsUser + IMPERSONATE; never sa/dbo
  • Generated SQL → review GRANT/REVOKE, dynamic SQL (parameterized sp_executesql), SELECT that exposes too much, DROP/TRUNCATE
  • Data sent to the model → classify (PII), compliance, IP; no training on your prompts; audit log 180 days without local prompts
  • Network → IP in the Azure SQL firewall, private endpoint/VPN, service principals

Security: agent and MCP

  • Approving ≠ security boundary: the boundary is SQL permissions (Copilot uses your login; SSMS Agent READ_ONLY by default)
  • Prompt injection / untrusted MCP → few tools, trust prompts, allowlist, sandboxEnabled (macOS/Linux)
  • Auto-approval (Allow always, Allow all, Autopilot) → per session; policy ChatToolsAutoApprove
  • Content exclusion (Business/Enterprise): ✘ Edit/Agent in VS Code, ✘ CLI, ✘ third-party MCP; instruction files guide, they do not guarantee

Chat: modes, model and tools

  • Ask 1 response (SSMS: read-only) · Edit · Agent multi-step with tools · Plan → plan.md
  • MCP ⇒ Agent mode (Ask does not support MCP); tools of a new server: disabled until checked (SSMS/Visual Studio)
  • SSMS: Tools → + → Add custom MCP server (Server ID + HTTP/stdio) / Add from MCP registry · VS Code: Configure Tools, max. 128 tools/request
  • Model: model picker; VS Code Auto and > arrow = thinking effort; Business/Enterprise: Editor Preview Features policy
  • BYOM SSMS: Manage Models → OpenAI · Anthropic · Google · xAI · Azure · Foundry Local; Azure: Display Name · Model ID (= deployment) · Resource Endpoint; only Chat, tool calling, ✘ Business/Enterprise

mcp.json: keys

  • stdio: type, command*, args, cwd, env, envFile · http/sse: type, url*, headers, oauth.clientId · dev, sandboxEnabled
  • inputs[]: id, type (promptString|pickString|command), description, password (false) → ${input:id}
  • MCP: Add Server (HTTP or Command stdio) · MCP: List Servers
{ "servers": { "azure-sql-mcp": { "type": "http", "url": "https://host/mcp",
    "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer ${input:azure_token}" } } } }

SSMS: instructions in the DB

  • Extended property AGENTS.md (object; 1 per object; 22.3+) · CONSTITUTION.md (class = 0; highest precedence)
  • @value ≤ 7,500 bytes; create: db_owner/db_ddladmin (not on the DB itself) or ALTER/CONTROL
  • CONSTITUTION.md + front matter agentExecuteAsUser (user or login; 22.7+) → EXECUTE AS; the user needs IMPERSONATE, otherwise, no Copilot
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'AGENTS.md',
  @value = N'Revenue = SUM(NetAmount) excluding refunds',
  @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'Finance',
  @level1type = N'TABLE',  @level1name = N'CompanyRevenue';

SQL MCP Server (DAB)

  • DAB ≥ 1.7 (2.0 GA); MCP 2025-06-18; HTTP + stdio; no NL2SQL or DDL
  • 7 tools: describe_entities, create_record, read_records, update_record, delete_record, execute_entity, aggregate_records (2.0+)
  • runtime.mcp: enabled, path ("/mcp"), description, dml-tools; aggregate-records.query-timeout 1–600 s (30)
  • orderby = array; no JOIN (view/SP); mcp entity: dml-tools, custom-tool (SP only)
  • stdio: role:<name> (anonymous), ≤ 1 MB; requires "mcp": {"enabled": true}
dab init --database-type mssql --connection-string "@env('MSSQL_CONNECTION_STRING')" --host-mode Development --config dab-config.json
dab add Products --source dbo.Products --permissions "anonymous:read"
dab start --mcp-stdio role:anonymous --config dab-config.json

MCP in Fabric

  • Base https://api.fabric.microsoft.com/v1/mcp
  • Data agent (lakehouse): /workspaces/{WorkspaceId}/dataagents/{DataAgentId}/agent; 1 tool; publish first; Settings → Model Context Protocol; scope https://api.fabric.microsoft.com/.default
  • Data Warehouse Preview: /dataPlane/sqlEndpoint (item: /dataPlane/workspaces/<workspace-id>/items/<item-id>/sqlEndpoint); tool executeSQL
  • Core: /core (workspaces, items, roles; does not read tables) · Local: fabric.vscode-fabric-mcp-server or npx -y @microsoft/fabric-mcp@latest server start --mode all

⚡ Quick sheet — Secure, optimize, and deploy database solutions

The essentials to memorize: syntax, values, limits and decision rules. The full details (with examples, sources and warnings) are in the sections of each module.

⚡ M5 · Implement data security and compliance with SQL — the essentials

Always Encrypted: keys Not in Fabric SQL DB

  • Driver encrypts/decrypts; the engine never sees the CMK or plaintext · CMK (AKV, cert store, HSM) encrypts the CEK (256 bits) · the CEK encrypts the column
  • Single algorithm AEAD_AES_256_CBC_HMAC_SHA_256 · CEK RSA_OAEP · 1–2 ENCRYPTED_VALUE per CEK (2 = rotation) · strings: _BIN2 collation
  • Provider: AZURE_KEY_VAULT · MSSQL_CERTIFICATE_STORE · MSSQL_CSP_PROVIDER · MSSQL_CNG_STORE · MSSQL_JAVA_KEYSTORE · custom with no MSSQL_ prefix
  • Keys and initial encryption: SSMS · PowerShell SqlServer · sqlpackage (not T-SQL; in-place only with enclave)
  • Client: Column Encryption Setting=Enabled · parameters only (literal → Msg 206) · to query: VIEW ANY COLUMN MASTER KEY DEFINITION + VIEW ANY COLUMN ENCRYPTION KEY DEFINITION (public only in SQL Server)
  • AKV: app get, unwrapKey, verify (Key Vault Crypto User) · rotate CMK: 2 values in the CEK → migrate apps → remove the old one
CREATE COLUMN MASTER KEY MyCMK WITH (KEY_STORE_PROVIDER_NAME = 'AZURE_KEY_VAULT', KEY_PATH = 'https://v.vault.azure.net/keys/k/ver');
CREATE COLUMN ENCRYPTION KEY MyCEK WITH VALUES (COLUMN_MASTER_KEY = MyCMK, ALGORITHM = 'RSA_OAEP', ENCRYPTED_VALUE = 0x01700000016C);
-- column:
SSN char(11) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2 ENCRYPTED WITH (COLUMN_ENCRYPTION_KEY = MyCEK,
    ENCRYPTION_TYPE = DETERMINISTIC, ALGORITHM = 'AEAD_AES_256_CBC_HMAC_SHA_256')

AE with secure enclaves 2019+ Windows

  • VBS: SQL Server (HGS/None) and Azure SQL DB non-DC-series (None) · SGX (DC-series): AAS, end of support Oct 31, 2027
  • Without Attestation Protocol ⇒ enclave disabled · None requires SqlClient 4.1+
  • SQL Server: sp_configure 'column encryption enclave type', 1 (0 none, 1 VBS) + restart · Azure SQL: preferredEnclaveType = VBS
  • Only randomized + enclave-enabled keys (ENCLAVE_COMPUTATIONS) + compat ≥ 160 · 2019: JOIN only nested loop, no ORDER/GROUP BY
  • In-place: ALTER COLUMN … ENCRYPTED WITH (…) WITH (ONLINE = ON) · CMK only cert store/AKV

Cell-level (column-level) Also in Fabric SQL DB

  • SMK → DMK → certificate/asymmetric key → symmetric key → varbinary (≤ 8,000 B) · keys inside the DB
  • ENCRYPTBYKEY(key_GUID, cleartext [, add_authenticator, authenticator]) → NULL if the key is not open · OPEN is valid per session · AES_128|192|256 (DES/RC4 deprecated)
CREATE SYMMETRIC KEY K1 WITH ALGORITHM = AES_256 ENCRYPTION BY CERTIFICATE Cert1;
OPEN SYMMETRIC KEY K1 DECRYPTION BY CERTIFICATE Cert1;
SELECT CONVERT(varchar(19), DECRYPTBYKEY(CardEnc)) FROM dbo.T;
CLOSE SYMMETRIC KEY K1;

TDE

  • Encrypts data, log and backups at rest; does not encrypt traffic
  • DPAPI → SMK → DMK → certificate (in master) → DEK AES_128|192|256 · back up the certificate · does not encrypt master/model/msdb; tempdb yes
  • encryption_state (sys.dm_database_encryption_keys): 1 unencrypted · 2 encrypting · 3 encrypted · 4 key change · 5 decrypting · 6 protector change
  • Azure SQL: ON by default (new DBs); service-managed AES-256 CBC, annual rotation; BYOK in AKV (not T-SQL) · Fabric: workspace CMK ⇒ automatic TDE
CREATE DATABASE ENCRYPTION KEY WITH ALGORITHM = AES_256 ENCRYPTION BY SERVER CERTIFICATE MyCert;
ALTER DATABASE MyDb SET ENCRYPTION ON;   -- OFF decrypts

Dynamic Data Masking

FunctionResult
default()XXXX · 0 · 1900-01-01 00:00:00.0000000 · byte 0
email()aXXX@XXXX.com
random(1,100)random; numeric only
partial(p,"pad",s)partial(0,"XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-",4)
datetime("Y")Y M D h m s · SQL Server 2022+
  • UNMASK (DB/schema/table/column; 2022+) needs SELECT · create/change/remove mask: ALTER ANY MASK + ALTER on the table · can be inferred with ad hoc WHERE
ALTER TABLE dbo.Cust ALTER COLUMN Phone ADD MASKED WITH (FUNCTION = 'partial(3, "-XXX-XX", 2)');
GRANT UNMASK ON dbo.Cust (Phone) TO Telemarketing;

Row-Level Security

  • FILTER (silent: SELECT/UPDATE/DELETE) vs BLOCK (error): AFTER INSERT | AFTER UPDATE | BEFORE UPDATE | BEFORE DELETE · no operation = all
  • SCHEMABINDING = ON by default (with OFF, SELECT/EXECUTE is needed; does not change with ALTER) · STATE: write ON
  • Applies to dbo/db_owner · ALTER ANY SECURITY POLICY + ALTER on the schema (+ SELECT/REFERENCES on the function)
  • UPDATE = BEFORE + AFTER (old vs new → trigger) · Fabric DW/Synapse: only FILTER
CREATE FUNCTION Security.fn(@TenantID int) RETURNS TABLE WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS RETURN SELECT 1 AS ok WHERE @TenantID = CAST(SESSION_CONTEXT(N'TenantID') AS int);
GO
CREATE SECURITY POLICY Security.P ADD FILTER PREDICATE Security.fn(TenantID) ON dbo.Orders,
    ADD BLOCK PREDICATE Security.fn(TenantID) ON dbo.Orders AFTER INSERT WITH (STATE = ON);

GRANT / DENY / REVOKE and roles

  • Server → DB → schema → object → column · GRANT … ON SCHEMA::x covers future objects · columns: only SELECT, REFERENCES, UPDATE, UNMASK
  • DENY beats GRANT · REVOKE only removes · table DENY does not override column GRANT · does not apply to sysadmin/owner
  • Roles: db_owner, db_securityadmin, db_accessadmin, db_backupoperator, db_ddladmin, db_datareader, db_datawriter, db_denydatareader, db_denydatawriter · Azure SQL DB: dbmanager, loginmanager
  • Ownership chaining: same owner ⇒ no check of the referenced object's permissions (not with dynamic SQL) · EXECUTE AS default CALLER

Passwordless: Entra and Managed Identity

  • Authentication=Active Directory …: Managed Identity (or MSI; UAMI: User Id=<client ID>) · Default (dev) · Workload Identity · Service Principal · Interactive · Device Code Flow · Password (deprecated)
  • Server Entra admin (az sql server ad-admin create) → CREATE USER [app] FROM EXTERNAL PROVIDER → minimal roles · Encrypt=True;TrustServerCertificate=False
  • Entra-only: az sql server ad-only-auth enable (needs Entra admin; SQL Server Contributor cannot) · > 2,048 groups ⇒ cannot sign in

Auditing

  • SQL Server: CREATE SERVER AUDIT … TO FILE | APPLICATION_LOG | SECURITY_LOG + specifications; starts OFF · QUEUE_DELAY 1000 ms · ON_FAILURE CONTINUE (default) | SHUTDOWN | FAIL_OPERATION
  • Azure SQL DB: portal/PS/CLI/REST/ARM → Storage (sqldbauditlogs), Log Analytics (SQLSecurityAuditEvents), Event Hubs · default BATCH_COMPLETED_GROUP + SUCCESSFUL_/FAILED_DATABASE_AUTHENTICATION_GROUP
  • MI: TO URL or EXTERNAL_MONITOR · Fabric: portal/REST → OneLake · immutable: Allow protected append writes
  • Auditing admins = auditing dbo · FAILED_LOGIN_GROUP does not apply to Azure SQL DB

Credential with Managed Identity (models / REST)

CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL [https://my-aoai.openai.azure.com]
WITH IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity', SECRET = '{"resourceid":"https://cognitiveservices.azure.com"}';
GRANT EXECUTE ANY EXTERNAL ENDPOINT TO [app];
GRANT REFERENCES ON DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL::[https://my-aoai.openai.azure.com] TO [app];
  • Name = URL without query string, same protocol + FQDN, more generic path · IDENTITY: HTTPEndpointHeaders | HTTPEndpointQueryString | Managed Identity | Shared Access Signature
  • Audience: https://cognitiveservices.azure.com · https://eventhubs.azure.net · function with Entra: APP_ID · role Cognitive Services OpenAI User · UAMI: the primary one is used
  • EXECUTE ON EXTERNAL MODEL::m · enable (2025/MI): sp_configure 'external rest endpoint enabled', 1

DAB: REST, GraphQL, MCP 2.0 GA

  • runtime.host.authentication.provider default Unauthenticated · EntraID (alias AzureAD) and Custom: jwt.audience + jwt.issuer · Simulator only in development · without permissions = inaccessible
  • No token ⇒ anonymous · token ⇒ authenticated · X-MS-API-ROLE with a role that is not in the claim ⇒ 403 · invalid token ⇒ 401 · 2.0 inheritance: named → authenticated → anonymous
  • fields.include/exclude inside the action · policy.database OData (@item.x eq @claims.y) only read/update/delete · missing claim ⇒ 403
  • allow-introspection default true · depth-limit null · pagination 100 / 100,000 · host.mode default production
  • MCP /mcp: 7 DML tools, dml-tools.delete-record: false, API key ⇒ APIM · RLS: set-session-context or OBO

Memorize: AE AEAD_AES_256_CBC_HMAC_SHA_256 · CEK 256 bits / RSA_OAEP · CEK cache 2 h · SGX end Oct 31, 2027 · Fabric CMK: ≤ 10 min to Inaccessible; if it recovers in ≤ 30 min, self-healing · DDM REGEXP_REPLACE Preview (Azure SQL DB only, T-SQL): pattern ≤ 8,000 B, LOB ≤ 2 MB, flags 'c' · session context 128 B / 8,000 B / 1 MB · audit: QUEUE_DELAY 1000 (0 = synchronous), MAXSIZE ≥ 2 MB, predicate ≤ 3,000 chars · REST: @timeout 1–230 s (30), @retry_count 0–10, 100 MB / 8 KB / 8 KB, 15% workers (max. 175) · DAB 100 / 100,000, MCP 30 s (1–600)
Learn vs current docs and traps:
  • DDM — Learn: 4 functions; “SELECT + ALTER bypasses the mask”. Docs: 5 (+ regex Preview); changing the mask requires ALTER ANY MASK + ALTER.
  • Auditing — Learn: ALTER DATABASE AUDIT SPECIFICATION in Azure SQL DB and Purview in Fabric. Docs: portal/PS/CLI/REST/ARM; Fabric → OneLake.
  • Models — Learn: Cognitive Services User, {"resourceId": "…com/"}, AzureOpenAICredential, TYPE = REST. Docs: Cognitive Services OpenAI User, {"resourceid":"https://cognitiveservices.azure.com"}, credential = URL, JSON_QUERY(@response,'$.result.data[0].embedding').
  • DAB — Learn: authentication at the root, fields in the permission, mcpServers. Docs: runtime.host.authentication, fields in the action, dml-tools. Fabric SQL DB — Learn suggests AE; docs: AE not supported.
  • DENY wins · RLS applies to db_owner · explicit STATE = ON · DDM and AE cannot be combined · TDE does not protect against users · email(): aXXX@XXXX.com / aXX@XXXX.com (SQL Server / Azure SQL)

⚡ M6 · Optimize database performance — the essentials

vCore vs DTU

  • vCore: GP · BC · Hyperscale; provisioned or serverless (GP, HS); you choose the hardware; reserved capacity + AHB; recommended for migrations
  • DTU (CPU + memory + reads + writes): Basic · Standard · Premium; no serverless; the eDTU (pools) costs 1.5× the DTU
  • avg_dtu_percent = MAX(avg_cpu_percent, avg_data_io_percent, avg_log_write_percent)
  • Basic 5 DTU · Standard S0 10 → S12 3000 · Premium P1 125 → P15 4000; Basic and S0–S2 < 1 vCore → CPU-intensive: S3+ (100 DTU)

Serverless · pools

  • Serverless: vCore only, GP and Hyperscale, Gen5; min 0.5 vCore; up to 80 vCores; billed per second; paused = storage only
  • Auto-pause: GP 15–10,080 min, default 60, -1 = off · HS Preview min. 60; only with sessions = 0 and CPU = 0; geo-replication, LTR, DNS alias prevent it
  • Resume ≈ 1 min: the first login fails with error 40613 → retry
  • Pool: low average and non-simultaneous peaks; no per-DB charge · zone redundancy: vCore GP/BC/HS, DTU Premium only
CREATE DATABASE d1 (EDITION = 'GeneralPurpose', SERVICE_OBJECTIVE = 'GP_S_Gen5_1');

Compat level · IQP · scoped configs

  • Default 170 (Azure SQL DB, Fabric; 100–170); never goes up on its own; restore/BACPAC keeps it
  • 140 adaptive joins · interleaved exec · 150 batch mode on rowstore · scalar UDF inlining · TV deferred compilation · 160 PSP · CE and DOP feedback · 170 OPPO
ALTER DATABASE CURRENT SET COMPATIBILITY_LEVEL = 170;
ALTER DATABASE SCOPED CONFIGURATION [FOR SECONDARY] SET MAXDOP = 8;
Scoped configDefault
MAXDOP0 · 8 in new Azure SQL DB databases
DOP_FEEDBACKOFF (2022) · ON (SQL Server 2025) · Azure SQL DB: GA Jul 2025
PARAMETER_SNIFFING · PSP · CE_FEEDBACK · OPPOON (PSP and CE from 160, OPPO from 170)

Automatic tuning

  • Azure defaults: FORCE_LAST_GOOD_PLAN ON · CREATE_INDEX OFF · DROP_INDEX OFF; better at the server + INHERIT on the DBs
  • Requires Query Store READ_WRITE; validates 30 min–72 h and reverts; applied manually via T-SQL = no validation
ALTER DATABASE CURRENT SET AUTOMATIC_TUNING = INHERIT;  -- | AUTO
ALTER DATABASE CURRENT SET AUTOMATIC_TUNING (CREATE_INDEX = ON, DROP_INDEX = ON);  -- CUSTOM

RCSI vs SNAPSHOT

  • RCSI = READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT: READ COMMITTED with a snapshot per statement, without changing code · default ON Azure SQL DB/Fabric, OFF SQL Server and MI; in Azure SQL DB the ALTER DATABASE is run from master
  • SNAPSHOT = ALLOW_SNAPSHOT_ISOLATION + SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL SNAPSHOT before starting the transaction; per transaction; update conflict = error 3960 (aborts → retry) · default ON Azure SQL DB, OFF SQL Server and MI
ALTER DATABASE CURRENT SET READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT ON WITH ROLLBACK IMMEDIATE;  -- SQL Server

Locks · escalation · hints

  • Escalation: a statement with ≥ 5,000 locks on a table/index reference (evaluated every 1,250) → row/key to table, never page
  • ALTER TABLE t SET (LOCK_ESCALATION = TABLE | AUTO | DISABLE): default TABLE · AUTO = partition · DISABLE does not prevent all of them
  • UPDLOCK (U; prevents S→X deadlock) · HOLDLOCK = SERIALIZABLE · READPAST · NOWAIT = LOCK_TIMEOUT 0
  • SET LOCK_TIMEOUT ms: -1 = wait forever (default) · error 1222 (does not roll back the transaction, unless XACT_ABORT ON)
  • Optimized locking (TID + LAQ; LAQ requires RCSI): always ON in Azure SQL DB/Fabric; SQL Server 2025: OFF

Query Store: options and defaults

ALTER DATABASE CURRENT SET QUERY_STORE = ON (OPERATION_MODE = READ_WRITE,
  CLEANUP_POLICY = (STALE_QUERY_THRESHOLD_DAYS = 30), QUERY_CAPTURE_MODE = AUTO);
OptionAzure SQL DBSQL Server
QUERY_STOREON, cannot be turned offOFF ≤ 2019 · ON 2022+
STALE_QUERY_THRESHOLD_DAYS30 (Basic 7)30
MAX_STORAGE_SIZE_MB1,024 (Premium/BC/HS) · 100 (Std/GP) · 10 (Basic); max. 10,240100 (2016–17) · 1,000 (2019+)
INTERVAL_LENGTH_MINUTES · DATA_FLUSH_INTERVAL_SECONDS60 (only 1·5·10·15·30·60·1440) · 900
SIZE_BASED_CLEANUP_MODE · MAX_PLANS_PER_QUERY · WAIT_STATS_CAPTURE_MODEAUTO (90% → ~80%) · 200 · ON
QUERY_CAPTURE_MODE (ALL·AUTO·NONE·CUSTOM)AUTOALL 2016–17 · AUTO 2019+

CUSTOM → QUERY_CAPTURE_POLICY: STALE_CAPTURE_POLICY_THRESHOLD 24 HOURS (1 h–7 d) · EXECUTION_COUNT 30 · TOTAL_COMPILE_CPU_TIME_MS 1000 · TOTAL_EXECUTION_CPU_TIME_MS 100 (OR)

Query Store: status · forcing · hints

EXEC sp_query_store_force_plan   @query_id = 42, @plan_id = 17;
EXEC sp_query_store_unforce_plan @query_id = 42, @plan_id = 17;
EXEC sys.sp_query_store_set_hints @query_id = 42, @query_hints = N'OPTION (MAXDOP 1)';
  • ALTER permission on the DB; forcing not guaranteed (force_failure_count); sys.sp_query_store_clear_hints removes hints
  • QS hints (SQL Server 2022+, Azure SQL, Fabric) override hints and plan guides; not supported: OPTIMIZE FOR (@v = val), MAXRECURSION, USE PLAN, table hints
  • sys.database_query_store_options: actual_state_desc ≠ desired_state_desc → readonly_reason 65536 = MAX_STORAGE_SIZE_MB reached → increase it

Plans and DMVs

  • Actual: SET STATISTICS XML ON (Ctrl+M) · estimated: SET SHOWPLAN_XML ON (Ctrl+L) · SHOWPLAN permission
  • Key Lookup → INCLUDE · scan → index · estimated ≪ actual → UPDATE STATISTICS · CONVERT_IMPLICIT → same types · missing index DMVs: max. 600 groups
DMVPurpose
dm_exec_requests · dm_exec_sessionswhat is running now (blocking_session_id, wait_type) · sessions, also sleeping
dm_exec_query_statscached plans (µs, execution_count) + dm_exec_sql_text/query_plan
dm_os_waiting_tasks · dm_tran_locks · dm_db_wait_statswho is waiting · locks · DB waits (dm_os_wait_stats = instance)
dm_db_resource_stats · sys.resource_statsevery 15 s, ~1 h · in master, 5 min, 14 d

Permission: VIEW DATABASE STATE (Azure SQL DB) · VIEW SERVER (PERFORMANCE) STATE (SQL Server, MI)

Query Performance Insight

  • Portal → Intelligent Performance; single/pooled only; requires Query Store enabled; no DDL · default top 5 by CPU; Custom: CPU/Duration/Execution count · 24 h/week/month · 5/10/20
  • RBAC: charts: Reader, Owner, Contributor, SQL DB Contributor, SQL Server Contributor; query text: the same except Reader
  • Database watcher Preview retires in 2027 → Database Hub (Fabric)

Blocking and deadlocks

  • Head blocker: blocking_session_id = 0 and blocks others; sleeping with an open transaction → KILL (ALTER ANY CONNECTION · Azure SQL DB: KILL DATABASE CONNECTION)
  • Deadlock monitor every 5 s (down to 100 ms) → error 1205; victim: lowest DEADLOCK_PRIORITY (LOW −5 · NORMAL 0 · HIGH 5 · −10…10), then the cheapest to roll back
  • Graph: victim-list · process-list · resource-list; Azure SQL DB: XE sqlserver.database_xml_deadlock_report ON DATABASE; SQL Server/MI: system_health
  • Retry 1205 · 3960 · 1222 with a random pause; after 1205 the transaction is already rolled back (XACT_STATE()); prevent: short transactions

READ UNCOMMITTEDYesYesYesno S locks (= NOLOCK)
READ COMMITTEDNoYesYesshort S locks · SQL Server default
READ COMMITTED SNAPSHOTNoYesYesrow versioning per statement · Azure SQL DB default
REPEATABLE READNoNoYesS locks until the end of the transaction
SNAPSHOTNoNoNorow versioning per transaction; update conflicts
SERIALIZABLENoNoNokey-range locks (= HOLDLOCK)
If the scenario says…ChooseTrap
Heavy reporting degrades OLTP, without changing the tierApplicationIntent=ReadOnly (BC/Premium/HS)GP has no read replica
SP fast yesterday, slow today (sniffing)Regressed Queries → sp_query_store_force_plan or QS hint RECOMPILEForcing not guaranteed
Readers block writers, without touching codeRCSI (already ON in Azure SQL DB)Writer ↔ writer does block
Double booking / phantomsUPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK or SERIALIZABLEMore blocking and deadlocks
Memorize: vCores 2–128 / 2–128 / 2–192 · 4 / 4 / 128 TB · IOPS/vCore 320 / 4,000 / 5,500 · serverless 0.5 vCore min., auto-pause 60 min (15–10,080) · MAXDOP 8 · compat 170 · escalation 5,000 locks (every 1,250) · deadlock monitor 5 s → 100 ms · 1205 / 1222 / 3960 · Query Store 60 min · 900 s · 30 d · 200 plans · 1,024/100/10 MB.
Learn vs current docs:
  • Plan: Learn “left to right, top to bottom” · Docs: right → left, top to bottom (data flow; SELECT on the left; both directions work).
  • Hyperscale: Learn “the widest variety of workloads” · Docs: “recommended and default tier” for new OLTP/HTAP; AHB no longer on new HS DBs.
  • ALLOW_SNAPSHOT_ISOLATION: Learn “you must enable it” · Docs: already ON in Azure SQL DB (OFF in SQL Server and MI).
  • QUERY_CAPTURE_MODE: Learn lab: ALL records short SP calls that AUTO “might skip” · Docs: SPs, cursors and natively compiled are always captured; default 2019+: ALTER DATABASE = AUTO, sys.database_query_store_options = ALL.
  • Learn “six levels” · SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL accepts 5. ROLLBACK in CATCH after 1205 · already rolled back (3903). 5%/30% fragmentation: classic heuristic.
  • Verify: DOP_FEEDBACK in Azure SQL DB (ON in SQL Server 2025; the reference still says “default OFF”) → sys.database_scoped_configurations · hint DISABLE_PARAMETER_SENSITIVE_PLAN (in the PSP doc, not in the USE HINT list) → sys.dm_exec_valid_use_hints.

SqlPackage: actions

ActionWhat it does
PublishIncremental diff; creates the DB if it does not exist (db_owner / CREATE DATABASE)

SqlPackage: parameters

  • /a Action · /sf SourceFile · /scs · /tcs · /tf TargetFile · /pr Profile · /p · /v SQLCMD · /at token · /dsp · /drp · /op · /df

Publish: defaults (/p:)

PropertyDefault
BlockOnPossibleDataLossTrue
DropObjectsNotInSourceFalse
DropIndexes/Constraints/DmlTriggers/Statistics/ExtendedPropertiesNotInSourceTrue
DropPermissionsNotInSource · DropRoleMembersNotInSourceFalse
CreateNewDatabase (drop + recreate)False
RegisterDataTierApplication · BlockWhenDriftDetectedFalse · True
GenerateSmartDefaults (NOT NULL with rows)False
CommandTimeout · LongRunningCommandTimeout · DatabaseLockTimeout60 · 0 · 60 s

Pre/post-deployment and reference data

  • Max. 1 <PreDeploy> + 1 <PostDeploy>; more files → :r .\Scripts\x.sql
  • They go in the .dacpac, are not compiled, run on every deploy (pre: the plan is already calculated)
  • :r files: <Build Remove="x.sql" /> + <None Include="x.sql" /> (otherwise the build fails)
  • Idempotent = MERGE; plain INSERT fails on the 2nd deploy; WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE THEN DELETE = full sync
  • <SqlCmdVariable Include="Env"> (DefaultValue + Value $(SqlCmdVar__1)) → $(Env) → /v:Env=prod
  • /p:IgnorePreDeployScript · /p:IgnorePostDeployScript (SqlPackage ≥ 170.1)

Schema drift

  • Drift = live DB ≠ project. Detect: Schema Compare DB → project (.scmp) · Extract + git status --porcelain | wc -l
  • DriftReport only with a registered DB (/p:RegisterDataTierApplication=True)
  • Compare options: Ignore whitespace · column order · partition schemes · Drop indexes not in source · Block on possible data loss
  • Resolve: import into the project (PR) or re-publish · Extract: IgnorePermissions=True

Testing

  • Layers: build (dotnet build) → unit → integration (dedicated DB + deployed project)
  • SSDT: pre-test → test → post-test · Row Count · Scalar Value (default null) · Expected Schema · Data Checksum · (Not) Empty ResultSet · Execution Time (30 s) · Inconclusive (default)
  • Negative: [ExpectedSqlException(Severity = 16, MatchFirstError = false, State = 1)]
  • CI: ADO VSTest@2 · GitHub dotnet test
  • tSQLt: NewTestClass · test… · FakeTable · ExpectException · RunAll; PrepareServer.sql = SA; never in production

GitHub Actions: deploy

permissions: { id-token: write, contents: read }
steps:
  - uses: azure/login@v3   # client-id · tenant-id · subscription-id
  - uses: azure/sql-action@v2.4
    with: { connection-string: "${{ secrets.CONN }}", path: ./Database.dacpac, action: publish }
  • Inputs: connection-string · path (.sql/.dacpac/.sqlproj) · action (Publish|Script|DeployReport|DriftReport) · arguments · build-arguments · sqlpackage-path · skip-firewall-check (≥ v2.3)
  • Build (-c Release -o ./output → artifact) → Deploy (needs + environment) with the same .dacpac; ubuntu-latest without SqlPackage
  • Azure SQL DB firewall: azure/login first (SQL Security Manager role); public Managed Instance: port 3342

OIDC and secrets

  • Issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com · audience api://AzureADTokenExchange
  • Subject: repo:ORG/REPO:environment:ENV · …:ref:refs/heads/BRANCH · …:pull_request · …:ref:refs/tags/TAG
  • ≤ 20 credentials per app · no wildcards · failure = AADSTS700213
  • DB: CREATE USER [app] FROM EXTERNAL PROVIDER + db_ddladmin (Publish: db_owner)
  • Authentication=Active Directory Default (OIDC) · Active Directory Managed Identity · Active Directory Service Principal
  • Secrets: repo/environment/org (the lowest one wins) · 100/100/1,000 · 48 KB · ADO AzureKeyVault@2 (Get + List)

Pipeline controls

  • Environment (GitHub): Required reviewers ≤ 6 (1 is enough) · Wait timer 1–43,200 min · Deployment branches and tags · Allow administrators to bypass
  • Branch protection (1 per branch) vs ruleset (several, ≤ 75, the most restrictive wins)
  • CODEOWNERS: .github/|root|docs/ · < 3 MB · the last match wins · owners with write · 1 owner is enough
  • ADO: approvals/checks (UI, not YAML): static → pre-approvals → dynamic → post-approvals → exclusive lock · Branch control = refs/heads/main · SqlAzureDacpacDeployment@1 (Windows agent)

⚡ M8 · Integrate SQL solutions with Azure services — the essentials

dab-config.json DAB 2.x GA

  • Root: $schema · data-source (required) · data-source-files · runtime · entities · autoentities (mssql, 2.0) · azure-key-vault
  • database-type: mssql (SQL Server 2016+, Azure SQL, Fabric SQL) · dwsql (Synapse, Fabric DW) · postgresql|mysql|cosmosdb_nosql|cosmosdb_postgresql
  • connection-string: @env('VAR') or @akv('x'); never in plain text, Base64 or credentials.json
  • options.set-session-context: omitted = true; dab init writes false; true ⇒ no cache
  • DAB_ENVIRONMENT=X ⇒ dab-config.X.json overrides the base (no variable: Production)

runtime: defaults

KeyDefault
pagination100 / 100000 (default-page-size / max-page-size); -1 = maximum
rest/api; request-body-strict true if omitted (dab init writes false)
graphql/graphql; allow-introspection true; depth-limit null
hostmode production; max-response-size-mb 158; cors.origins []; allow-credentials false

Authentication and roles

  • provider: Unauthenticated (default 2.0+) · EntraID/AzureAD and Custom (require jwt.audience + jwt.issuer) · AppService (EasyAuth) · StaticWebApps · Simulator (development only)
  • Role: header X-MS-API-ROLE; omitted ⇒ authenticated. Inheritance: role → authenticated → anonymous

Entity and permissions

  • source { object, type: table|view|stored-procedure, parameters[] }; fields[] { name, alias, description, primary-key } replaces mappings and key-fields (deprecated, cannot be mixed)
  • rest.methods and graphql.operation SP only: methods lowercase array (default post); operation mutation (default) | query; graphql.type { singular, plural }
  • actions: table/view create|read|update|delete|* · SP execute; read-only ⇒ only read; PUT/PATCH = create + update
  • fields.include|exclude hides columns; policy.database (@item.col, @claims.x) only read/update/delete

L1 / L2 cache

  • Two switches: runtime.cache.enabled and entities.<n>.cache.enabled (both false); ttl-seconds 5, the entity inherits
  • level: L1 (memory) | L1L2 (default: L1 → L2 Redis → DB; no global level-2 = L1); level-2: provider, connection-string, partition
  • REST Cache-Control: no-cache (refreshes) / no-store; no cache with set-session-context: true or OBO

Views · SP · relationships

  • View: no detectable PK ⇒ fields[].primary-key: true; no relationships
  • SP: execute; 1st result set; no pagination/filtering/sorting; parameters [{ name, required, default, description }]; REST POST (default) or GET; GraphQL executeX(args)
  • Relationship (GraphQL only): cardinality one|many, target.entity, source.fields, target.fields; N:M: linking.object, linking.source.fields, linking.target.fields; define on both sides
QueryREST (/api/{entity})GraphQL (POST /graphql)
List · key{ "value": […], "nextLink" } · /api/Book/id/1books { items { … } hasNextPage endCursor } · book_by_pk(id: 1)
Filter$filter=year ge 1970 and title eq 'Dune': eq ne gt ge lt le and or not; null eq nullfilter: { year: { gte: 1970 } }: eq neq gt gte lt lte and or contains notContains startsWith endsWith in isNull
Order · fields$orderby=year desc, title asc · $select=id,titleorderBy: { year: DESC } · selection set
Pagination (keyset)$first=N · $after=<token>first: N · after: "<endCursor>"

first omitted ⇒ 100; -1 ⇒ maximum; 0, < -1 or greater than the maximum ⇒ 400. GraphQL writes with createX(item:), updateX(id:, item:), deleteX(id:).

CLI dab

dab init --database-type mssql --connection-string "@env('DATABASE_CONNECTION_STRING')" --host-mode development
dab add Book --source dbo.Books --permissions "anonymous:read"
dab update Book --permissions "authenticated:*"
dab validate    # without starting; exit 0 = OK
dab start       # HTTP 5000 / HTTPS 5001
  • dotnet tool install --global Microsoft.DataApiBuilder (docs: .NET 8+; 2.1.x targets .NET 10) · init overwrites; add: -s and --permissions required (1 role per run); also configure, add-telemetry, auto-config, export

DAB hosting Azure

  • Container Apps GA: serverless, scale-to-zero, MI; --target-port 5000; image mcr.microsoft.com/azure-databases/data-api-builder + COPY dab-config.json /App/dab-config.json
  • App Service GA: ZIP with dab-config.json + startup.sh (LF) + dab/; ASPNETCORE_URLS=http://0.0.0.0:8080; provider AppService

Azure Monitor for Azure SQL

  • Automatic platform metrics; resource logs only with a diagnostic setting (≤ 3 per resource; one per DB and per elastic pool)
  • Destinations: Log Analytics (KQL, AzureDiagnostics, ≤ 15 min) · Event Hubs (SIEM, same region) · Storage (cheap archive)
  • Categories: SQLInsights AutomaticTuning QueryStoreRuntimeStatistics QueryStoreWaitStatistics Errors DatabaseWaitStatistics Timeouts Blocks Deadlocks + Basic metrics
  • Alerts: cpu_percent Avg > 90 · workers_percent Min > 60 · storage_percent Min > 95. Database watcher Preview retires Apr 30, 2027 → Database Hub Preview

App Insights and Log Analytics with DAB

  • azure-log-analytics: auth with table …_CL, dcr-immutable-id, dce-endpoint; MI with role Monitoring Metrics Publisher
  • Container Apps → Log Analytics: az containerapp env update --logs-workspace-id; table ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
  • P95 > 2 s ⇒ App Insights + KQL percentile(duration, 95) (log alert); dab add-telemetry configures App Insights/OTel

Enable CES Preview

Enable CDC, CT; Functions and Logic Apps

  • Learn: dab start --config dab-config.production.json merges; mappings; rest.methods object; cache inside graphql; parameters dictionary / Current docs: merges DAB_ENVIRONMENT; fields[].alias; methods array, SP only; cache alongside rest/graphql; parameters array.
  • Learn: SWA with az staticwebapp dbconnection create --db-type and staticwebapps.database.config.json / Current docs: retired; no --db-type; file staticwebapp.database.config.json.
  • Learn: DAB “detects” APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING; requests/failed > 5 = “5%” / Current docs: you must enable application-insights; it is a count.
  • Learn: CREATE EVENT STREAMING GROUP … TARGET_TYPE='eventhub', CES “sub-second”, [FunctionName] / Current docs: sp_create_event_stream_group, near real-time, Preview; [Function].

⚡ Quick sheet — Implement AI capabilities in database solutions

The essentials to memorize: syntax, values, limits and decision rules. The full details (with examples, sources and warnings) are in the sections of each module.

⚡ M9 · Design and implement models and embeddings with SQL — the essentials

CREATE EXTERNAL MODEL GA

OptionValue / rule
AUTHORIZATIONmodel owner (optional; the current user by default)
LOCATIONHTTPS URL (TLS); ONNX: local folder
API_FORMATAzure OpenAI · OpenAI · Ollama · ONNX Runtime (required)
MODEL_TYPEEMBEDDINGS only
MODELmodel name (required); the deployment goes in the URL
CREDENTIALDATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL (optional)
PARAMETERSJSON appended to the body: {"dimensions":n} · {"sql_rest_options":{"retry_count":n}} (n = 0–10)
LOCAL_RUNTIME_PATHONNX Runtime folder Preview (Windows)

LOCATION and credential

Azure OpenAI: https://{endpoint}/openai/deployments/{deployment-id}/embeddings?api-version={date}
OpenAI:       https://{server_name}/v1/embeddings
Ollama:       https://localhost:{port}/api/embed
  • Credential name = base URL: same protocol + FQDN, no query string, path more generic than LOCATION; ≤ 128 chars; does not start with #
  • Managed Identity: IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity', SECRET = '{"resourceid":"https://cognitiveservices.azure.com"}'
  • API key: IDENTITY = 'HTTPEndpointHeaders', SECRET = '{"api-key":"…"}' (OpenAI: {"Bearer":"…"}); also HTTPEndpointQueryString and SHARED ACCESS SIGNATURE

Prerequisites, permissions and roles

WhatRequirement
Enable RESTsp_configure 'external rest endpoint enabled', 1: ON by default in Azure SQL DB/Fabric; OFF in SQL Server 2025/MI
Create credentialmaster key first (Azure SQL DB creates it automatically) + CONTROL on the DB
Create/alter modelCREATE EXTERNAL MODEL o ALTER ANY EXTERNAL MODEL
Use the modelGRANT EXECUTE ON EXTERNAL MODEL::m (by default only the owner)
Direct RESTsp_invoke_external_rest_endpoint: EXECUTE ANY EXTERNAL ENDPOINT + REFERENCES; @retry_count 0–10, @timeout 1–230 s (default 30)
Allow list (Azure SQL DB/MI)*.openai.azure.com, *.cognitiveservices.azure.com, *.azure-api.net; not *.services.ai.azure.com or api.openai.com

ALTER / DROP / diagnostics

  • ALTER EXTERNAL MODEL m SET ( MODEL = '…' ): changes endpoint/credential without touching the code; does not regenerate vectors
  • DROP EXTERNAL MODEL m: no IF EXISTS; does not delete the credential (and it cannot be deleted while a model uses it)
  • Catalog sys.external_models · a SCHEMABINDING view that uses the model prevents the DROP
  • Msg 15151: no EXECUTE, or creating and using the model in the same batch (separate with GO) · 31630: credential name does not match LOCATION · 33047: Managed Identity without resourceid

AI_GENERATE_EMBEDDINGS GA

AI_GENERATE_EMBEDDINGS ( source USE MODEL model_identifier [ PARAMETERS optional_json_request_body_parameters ] )
DECLARE @q vector(1536) = AI_GENERATE_EMBEDDINGS(N'consulta' USE MODEL m);
  • source: char/varchar/nchar/nvarchar (text only)
  • Used as a scalar function (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, MERGE, procs, triggers); JSON → vector(n)
  • PARAMETERS per query override the model's; retry_count 0–10
  • 1 HTTP call per value → batches: UPDATE TOP (n) t SET emb = AI_GENERATE_EMBEDDINGS(…) WHERE emb IS NULL + WAITFOR DELAY
  • Dims that differ from vector(n) give Msg 42204; NULL as input gives Msg 8116 (observed)

Vector type

TopicValue
Syntaxvector(n [, float32 | float16]), default float32; VECTORPROPERTY(v, 'Dimensions' | 'BaseType')
Max. dimsfloat32 ≤ 1,998 · float16 ≤ 3,996 (min. 1)
Bytes4 / 2 per dim (1,536 dims ≈ 6,148 B of DATALENGTH)
float16GA Azure SQL DB/MI/Fabric · Preview SQL Server 2025 (PREVIEW_FEATURES = ON)
Conversionchar/nchar/varchar/nvarchar/json ↔ vector; float32 ↔ float16 no (42238)
Errors42204 dims ≠ · 13670 not a JSON array · 42211 target too short
Limitsonly NULL/NOT NULL (no DEFAULT/CHECK/PK/FK/UNIQUE); no B-tree/columnstore (INCLUDE allowed); not memory-optimized

AI_GENERATE_CHUNKS

SELECT c.chunk, c.chunk_order FROM dbo.Doc AS d
CROSS APPLY AI_GENERATE_CHUNKS(SOURCE = d.Body, CHUNK_TYPE = FIXED,
            CHUNK_SIZE = 1000, OVERLAP = 10, ENABLE_CHUNK_SET_ID = 1) AS c;
ParameterRule
CHUNK_TYPEliteral FIXED (the only one)
CHUNK_SIZEcharacters, not tokens; required with FIXED; not NULL/0/negative
OVERLAP% of CHUNK_SIZE, integer 0–50, default 0
ENABLE_CHUNK_SET_ID1 returns chunk_set_id; omitted/NULL/0 does not
Columnschunk · chunk_order (1…n) · chunk_offset (1-based) · chunk_length · chunk_set_id
Requirementcompat ≥ 170; no network or credential

What to embed and how to chunk

  • Include: titles, descriptions, summaries, notes/reviews, category · Exclude: IDs/GUID, numerics, dates, flags, operational metadata (consume tokens, worsen similarity)
  • Many short fields → a single text (CONCAT_WS) or JSON
  • Large chunk: exceeds the token limit and dilutes focus · small: loses context, more rows/calls/cost
  • FIXED (+ OVERLAP) · paragraph/sentence: REGEXP_SPLIT_TO_TABLE (compat 170) or STRING_SPLIT(t, sep, 1) · semantic/by tokens: outside SQL

Evaluate models (4 criteria from Learn)

  • Modality: AI_GENERATE_EMBEDDINGS text only; multimodal (e.g. Cohere embed-v-4-0) is generated externally
  • Language: multilingual → text-embedding-3-large (MIRACL 54.9)
  • Size: large = more reasoning, latency and cost; a small one is enough for embeddings
  • Structured output: response_format json_schema + strict: true (Responses API: text.format) ≠ JSON mode (valid JSON only)
  • Chat/vision/JSON → sp_invoke_external_rest_endpoint; compare in the Foundry Models catalog; preview does not go to production

Keep text, model and vector aligned

  • Columns: SourceHash binary(32) = HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', text), ModelName/version, EmbeddedAt; Embedding IS NULL = pending; rowversion gives false positives (any UPDATE)
  • Model change: in-place (same dims; SET Embedding = NULL and batch) or blue/green (new column/table + new EXTERNAL MODEL; different dims; rollback)
  • There is no “upgrade” between models: everything is regenerated; never mix models or dimensions

⚡ M10 · Design and implement intelligent search with SQL — the essentials

Full-text · index

CREATE FULLTEXT CATALOG c AS DEFAULT;
CREATE FULLTEXT INDEX ON dbo.T (Name LANGUAGE 1033)
KEY INDEX PK_T ON c
WITH (CHANGE_TRACKING = AUTO, STOPLIST = SYSTEM);
  • KEY INDEX: unique, 1 column, NOT NULL (preferably int). 1 FT index per table; ≤ 1,024 columns.
  • Defaults: CHANGE_TRACKING = AUTO, STOPLIST = SYSTEM. Virtual catalog (name ≤ 120).
  • NO POPULATION only with CHANGE_TRACKING OFF (otherwise, error). INCREMENTAL requires timestamp.
  • Permissions: REFERENCES (catalog) + ALTER (table).
  • SQL Server 2025 v2 indexes (FULLTEXT_INDEX_VERSION 1 | 2, default 2); after an in-place upgrade the v1 ones fail → ALTER FULLTEXT CATALOG … REBUILD. Full-text: GA except Fabric Preview.

Full-text · queries and RANK

FormWhereReturns
CONTAINS, FREETEXTWHERErows, no rank
CONTAINSTABLE, FREETEXTTABLEFROM[KEY], [RANK]
  • *TABLE(table, cols, N'text' [, LANGUAGE l] [, top_n_by_rank]) + JOIN … ON pk = k.[KEY].
  • '"light*"' prefix (double quotes) · FORMSOF(INFLECTIONAL, ride) · NEAR((a,b), 10, TRUE) (2–64 terms; default MAX, FALSE).
  • NOT only after AND; nvarchar condition (not (max)). FREETEXT: no operators/NEAR/WEIGHT.
  • RANK 0–1000; BM25 (k1 1.2, b 0.75, k3 8.0) only in FREETEXTTABLE.
  • Inflections: FORMSOF and FREETEXT; synonyms (MTB): thesaurus only.
FTS vs vector vs hybridFull-textVectorHybrid
Choose if…SKU, error, exact phrase, technical termthe user describes the need; synonyms, paraphrasesyou do not know how they search; RAG; maximum recall
T-SQLCONTAINS/FREETEXT/*TABLE (FT index)VECTOR_DISTANCE / VECTOR_SEARCH (vector column, same model)CTEs + FULL OUTER JOIN + RRF
OrderRANK DESCdistance ASCrrf_score DESC
Trade-offhigh precision, few resultsmore recall; may miss the key termbetter recall, little loss of precision; slower

vector type

col VECTOR(1536) NULL             -- float32 (default)
col VECTOR(3996, float16) NULL    -- half-precision
BaseB/dimMax. dim
float32 (default)41,998
float1623,996
  • Size = 8 B + dim × B/dim (8,060 B page): vector(1536) 6,152 B · vector(1024) 4,104 B. 3-large (3,072 dim) → dimensions or float16.
  • Only NULL/NOT NULL (no PK/FK/UNIQUE/DEFAULT/CHECK); no B-tree/columnstore (INCLUDE allowed), memory-optimized, Always Encrypted or sparse.
  • Errors: 42204 (dim ≠ elements) · 13670 (not a JSON array) · 42211 (target too short) · 42238 (float32 ⇄ float16; they cannot be mixed in VECTOR_DISTANCE either).
  • sys.columns: vector_dimensions, vector_base_type (0 = float32, 1 = float16).

Vector functions

VECTOR_DISTANCE('cosine', @a, @b)  -- | 'euclidean' | 'dot'
VECTOR_NORMALIZE(@v, 'norm2')      -- model not normalized (Azure OpenAI is)
VECTOR_NORM(@v, 'norm2')           -- float
VECTORPROPERTY(@v, 'Dimensions')   -- debug dims; 'BaseType' → sysname
MetricRangeNote
cosine[0, 2]0 identical, 2 opposite
euclidean[0, +∞)0 identical
dot(−∞, +∞)negative dot product
  • norm1 Σ|x| · norm2 Euclidean (common) · norminf max|x|; VECTOR_NORMALIZE → length 1. [1,2,3] → 6.0 / 3.7416… / 3.0. Lower distance = more similar (ORDER BY ASC, also with dot).
  • VECTOR_DISTANCE is exact: it never uses the index.

CREATE VECTOR INDEX

CREATE VECTOR INDEX vec_idx ON dbo.T (Vec)
WITH (METRIC = 'cosine',  -- | 'dot' | 'euclidean'
      TYPE = 'DiskANN',   -- only type (default)
      MAXDOP = 0)         -- default 0
[ON filegroup];
  • METRIC: no documented default; same as in VECTOR_SEARCH (and the same column) or the index is not used (warning + kNN).
  • ALTER permission on the table. ≥ 100 rows with a non-NULL vector (v3) or Msg 42266. DROP INDEX removes it; moving to v3 = DROP + CREATE (no in-place upgrade).
  • Not partitionable or replicated; TRUNCATE blocked; no DACPAC (BACPAC yes, DacFx ≥ 170.5.96).
  • sys.vector_indexes (vector_index_type, distance_metric, build_parameters → $.Version 3 = v3); DMV sys.dm_db_vector_indexes (graph_catchup_pending_percent).
